entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor lithomancer and planeswalker from Zendikar, once Sorin's student, who was imprisoned in the Helvault after fighting him and swears vengeance on Innistrad after finding Zendikar ruined.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: An ancient vampire planeswalker who created the Helvault and an angel, and who imprisons Nahiri when she demands he honor their agreement.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel with white hair and dark eyes made by Sorin as his enforcer; this page does not name her.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker who agreed with Sorin to return if needed against the Eldrazi but never answered Nahiri's call.

entities.name: Tenri
entities.description: A tall kor woman with a scarred shoulder who heals Nahiri's hands and tells her of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Erem
entities.description: A kor sentry festooned with weapons and ropes who tells Nahiri of Bala Ged.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that has devoured Bala Ged, leaving gray dust.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrous beings imprisoned on Zendikar by Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin, who escaped and devastated the plane.

entities.name: Kamsa, Talib and Mangeni
entities.description: Gods of the kor whom some believe the three Eldrazi titans to be; Talib's statue calls Nahiri its prophet.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane, devastated by the escaped Eldrazi.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Sorin's plane, shaped by him, with a silver moon and the Helvault.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The chaotic space between worlds through which planeswalkers travel.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A forty-foot silver monolith made by Sorin as half of Innistrad's protection, which absorbs Nahiri and houses demons.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The chamber in Akoum at the heart of the hedron array that contained the Eldrazi, now collapsed.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A volcanic continent of Zendikar where Nahiri's tribe once wandered and the titans rose.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar devoured by Ulamog into gray dust.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: The people of Zendikar to whom Nahiri belongs, whose traditions survived the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Creatures imprisoned in the Helvault that batter Nahiri in the dark.

events.summary: After resealing the Eldrazi, Nahiri travels through the Blind Eternities to find Sorin.
events.quote: Nahiri cast herself through the chaos of the Blind Eternities, the space between worlds.

events.summary: Nahiri arrives on a bluff on Innistrad and finds the Helvault instead of Sorin.
events.quote: On the highest part of the bluff, where she had sensed his presence, stood instead a massive, rough-hewn chunk of silver

events.summary: Sorin appears behind Nahiri and she greets him joyfully.
events.quote: My friend!" she managed to say at last. "You're alive!

events.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
events.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

events.summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
events.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

events.summary: Flashback: Early in their acquaintance, Sorin broke Nahiri's arm in a lesson and told her she was no longer mortal.
events.quote: You broke my arm!

events.summary: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement.
events.quote: You risked my plane, and more.

events.summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
events.quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

events.summary: Sorin tells Nahiri he owes her nothing and that he molded her, telling her to bother Ugin instead.
events.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

events.summary: Nahiri calls up a granite column and swirling stone darts, declaring she is not going anywhere.
events.quote: She called forth a column of rock from the depths beneath them

events.summary: Nahiri's stone column swallows Sorin and he breaks free in a burst of light.
events.quote: but the stone column simply swallowed him.

events.summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
events.quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

events.summary: Nahiri sinks into the earth to escape the light and reconsider.
events.quote: She dug her hands into the soil, extending her will not out, but down, and dove into the earth itself.

events.summary: Nahiri forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
events.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

events.summary: An angel crashes out of the sky and slams into Nahiri.
events.quote: Then everything went bright again, brighter than the moon, and a shape came screaming out of the heavens.

events.summary: Sorin stops Nahiri's sword with his own and explains the angel is the other half.
events.quote: The other half,

events.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
events.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

events.summary: Inside the Helvault, Nahiri falls through darkness, unable to planeswalk.
events.quote: She tried to planeswalk, but even the Blind Eternities, the chaotic no-place between planes, was beyond her reach.

events.summary: Nahiri holds on to sanity by building a mental model of Zendikar.
events.quote: Her memories of Zendikar became her lantern in the dark.

events.summary: The Helvault is slowly populated by demons and horrors, and Nahiri understands its purpose.
events.quote: Slowly, over countless years, the Helvault was populated.

events.summary: The angel enters the Helvault to fight the demons and Nahiri realizes Sorin made her.
events.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

events.summary: The void cracks and the Helvault shatters, freeing Nahiri and the angel.
events.quote: And then there was light, real light, as the void around them cracked and shredded and finally...

events.summary: A year ago, Nahiri lands in a cobblestone street in Thraben amid chaos as the angel rises in white light.
events.quote: Nahiri slammed into a surface on her hands and knees, her endless fall over at last.

events.summary: Nahiri finds her body wounded and mortal-like, no longer an extension of her will.
events.quote: Her body was no longer an extension of her sense of self.

events.summary: Nahiri planeswalks home to Zendikar.
events.quote: Her feet found the rocky earth of Zendikar, and for the first time since her imprisonment began, she stood on solid ground.

events.summary: Nahiri finds the Eye of Ugin collapsed and the three Eldrazi titans escaped.
events.quote: But the Eye was a ruin, collapsed in on itself.

events.summary: Kor sentries find Nahiri and Tenri heals her wounds.
events.quote: The tall woman raised her hands, setting them aglow with healing magic.

events.summary: The kor tell Nahiri of the titans' rise and that some believe they are their old gods.
events.quote: three enormous monstrosities rose out of the Teeth of Akoum.

events.summary: Nahiri finds Bala Ged turned to lifeless gray dust.
events.quote: What stretched before her was a seemingly endless expanse of chalky gray dust

events.summary: Nahiri sees Ulamog on the horizon.
events.quote: The Devourer. The one Ugin called Ulamog .

events.summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
events.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

relations.note: He claims to have molded her.
relations.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

relations.note: Nahiri realizes he made the angel.
relations.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.
This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

relations.note: She swears vengeance after her imprisonment.
relations.quote: As I have wept, so will Sorin.

relations.note: The angel waits for Sorin's signal.

relations.quote: the angel had attacked her, unprovoked.

relations.note: She stood vigil as their warden on Zendikar.
relations.quote: I promised to chain myself to Zendikar to watch over them as their warden.

relations.note: She is a kor of Zendikar.
